To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we introduce a new column sampling algorithm called oASIS that is guaranteed to exactly solve the kernel matrix approximation problem; 2) oASIS is the first column sampling algorithm that is guaranteed to recover the optimal number of columns to select for kernel matrix approximation; 3) oASIS achieves comparable performance to the state of the art adaptive sampling methods, while requiring significantly less computation time and memory.
we introduce a novel adaptive column sampling algorithm that is guaranteed to exactly reconstruct the kernel matrix with the optimal number of samples.

oASIS is a fast, adaptive sampling algorithm for kernel matrices that is provably guaranteed to exactly recover any kernel matrix. oASIS is the first sampling algorithm to provably recover the kernel matrix for all kernel functions that have been proposed in the literature.
